topic: Subordinate Clauses, V2 Alteration, Clitics, Dative Experiencers, and Bukhari Hadith 1

ownerExamples.english: He did not go out, because he read the book.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: سُہ نیٚر نَہ نؠبَر، تِکیازِ تٔمۍ پٔر کِتاب۔

ownerExamples.english: He passed the examination, because he read the book diligently.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: سُہ سپُد امتحانَس مَنٛز پاس، تِکیازِ تٔمۍ پٔر کِتاب دِل سۭتۍ۔

ownerExamples.english: Because he read the book, therefore he knows the answer.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: تِکیازِ تٔمۍ پٔر کِتاب، أمِہ موجوٗب زانان چھُ سُہ جواب۔

ownerExamples.english: The reward of deeds depends only upon intentions.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: سارِوٕے کٲمَن ہُنٛد دار و مَدار چھُ صِرف نِیَّتَن پؠٹھ۔

ownerExamples.english: Every person will get the reward according to what they intended.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: ہَر اَکِس اِنسانَس مِلِہِ سۄے چیٖز، یِتھٕچ تٔمۍ نِیَّت کٔر۔

ownerExamples.english: I told him the complete story.
I gave it to you yesterday.
I feel cold in the morning.
Whoever seeks diligently will find the truth.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: یُس دِل سۭتۍ ژھارِ، سُہ لَبِ سۆچ۔

ownerExamples.english: Where there is desire, there a path is found.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: یۆت شَوق آسِ، تَتھ چھِ وَتھ میلان۔

ownerExamples.english: When you come to Srinagar, then we will go to the garden.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: ییلہِ ژٕ سِریٖنَگَر یِکھ، تِیلہِ پَکو عٔسۍ باغ۔

ownerExamples.english: He walked continuously all the way to the city.
ownerExamples.kashmiri: سُہ پۆک پَکان پَکان شَہَر تام۔

notes: Covers subordinate conjunction tikyazi, ergative past agreement, pronominal fused clitics, and dative psychological experiencers.
